description: GeomEffiBEM is a small Python geometry library contributed by EffiBEM for building-energy modelling. It was developed as a testbed for geometry operations used in OpenStudio and EnergyPlus, then published as a reusable package. The README links a demonstration notebook and documentation and describes efficient geometry creation and simple two-dimensional visualisation with matplotlib. Public source and Python package distribution are free under MIT. Coverage is user-defined building geometry, not a measured building inventory; there is no fixed geographic location, observation period or spatial resolution. The library's limited scope is a caveat: it provides geometry operations, not a full building-energy model or a calibrated stock dataset. Detailed supported geometry cases must be checked in its documentation before use, and none were executed in this review. It can help construct or inspect geometric inputs for building simulation workflows. It relates to both the catalogue's OpenStudio toolkit (platform-openstudio) and EnergyPlus engine (model-energyplus), which the maintainer explicitly names as its intended contexts.
